messages:
Elena (Finance): Quick update for the org: starting 2026-05-01 were introducing a few billing clarity items aimed at reducing surprise charges and giving customers a predictable reconciliation window. Please hold external comms until we publish the FAQ next week. :loudspeaker:

Marco (Customer Success): High level please? I have a couple of accounts worried about nightly spikes.

Elena (Finance): TL;DR: 1) One 24-hour grace window per 7-day rolling period (auto-applied) for sudden usage spikes, 2) a sustained-usage adjustment that only triggers after 7 consecutive days above configured thresholds, and 3) invoice finalization moves to the 3rd business day to allow a short reconciliation/batching window.

Devon (Sales Ops): What exactly is "sustained" here? Customers will ask for a strict definition.

Elena (Finance): Definition summary: sustained = either >60% of reserved pool (we adjusted to 60% for clarity) or >2x baseline for 7 consecutive days. Were calling the billing line item "SUSTAINED_ADJUSTMENT" rather than surcharge to emphasize it's an alignment adjustment.

Ish (Product): Any functional changes? SDKs? Rate-limits?

Elena (Finance): No change to rate-limits. Product will add a 70% soft-warning banner and a one-click "request a usage amortization" button for accounts that hit repeated short bursts. The amortization request will flag accounts for a one-time review by billing ops.

SupportBot: Note: grandfather rule applied for legacy free credits: accounts created before 2024-01-01 are exempt from automatic free-credit pruning until 2026-12-31, unless they opt into newer terms. Rule: GC-LEGACY-24.

Marco (Customer Success): Good. How will this appear on invoices and in the UI? Need sample language for outreach.

Elena (Finance): Invoice/UI changes: invoices will include explicit line items: "GRACE_WINDOW_CREDIT" and "SUSTAINED_ADJUSTMENT" with short explainers. Were also adding a new field in billing CSVs called "chargeback_tag" so partners can map adjustments to internal cost centers. Example invoice excerpt (for docs only):
```
INVOICE_DATE: 2026-05-03
LINE_ITEMS:
 - BASE_USAGE: $1,450
 - GRACE_WINDOW_CREDIT: -$37 (1x 24h grace applied)
 - SUSTAINED_ADJUSTMENT: $180 (7-day sustained alignment)
TOTAL: $1,593
```

Devon (Sales Ops): Are credits automatic? And how about disputed adjustments?

Elena (Finance): Grace credits auto-apply. Sustained adjustments trigger an automatic notification and a 10-day review window where customers can dispute. Disputes go to billing ops queue with a 5-business-day SLA. If the customer is in an active sales negotiation or has a partner tag, we defer enforcement until the negotiated date.

Ish (Product): Rollout plan and comms timeline?

Elena (Finance): Rollout: internal notes & playbook 2026-04-11; targeted notices to impacted customers 2026-04-21; public blog + FAQ 2026-04-29; enforcement dates: grace window & invoice cadence: 2026-05-01; sustained adjustment enforcement & optional free-credit taper: 2026-06-01. Playbook with AE templates will be posted in #support-channels tomorrow morning.

Marco (Customer Success): Any exceptions for pilots or enterprise partners?

Elena (Finance): Yes. Negotiated enterprise terms and pilot flags remain exempt. Were also keeping a limited partner-exemption table for resellers.

Devon (Sales Ops): Ops action items?

Ish (Product): Ops/Product to add the 70% banner, a /quota-amortize internal endpoint for testing, and a new CSV field for chargeback_tag before the public FAQ.

SupportBot: Automation note: billing-notify workflow updated (wf-id: BILL-NOTIFY-2026-04). Will post audit logs to #billing-ops when live.

Elena (Finance): Thanks everyone. Please wait for the published FAQ before talking externally. Ping me for any clarifications; will share AE scripts and dispute flow shortly. :handshake:
